name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 9 - Am 110
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 9 b. Opposes the introduction of new own resources for the Union; stresses that the implementation of the Commission’s proposals in this area would further increase the tax burden on citizens and businesses;
